snippet.title: Ecliptica Devlog 12:  Explosive update, weapons, bombs and destruction of the open world.
snippet.description:
Steam page : https://store.steampowered.com/app/3723390/Ecliptica/
Engine:  Qt Quick 3D https://doc.qt.io/qt-6/qtquick3d-index.html


What's New in This Devlog:

    Multi-Mode Tool System: All tools and weapons now feature multiple operational modes. You can equip up to 6 different tools at once and switch their functions on the fly without opening the menu.

    Advanced Terrabeams: Added three specialized modes for terrain manipulation:
        Mining: Extracting resources from deep underground.
        Leveling: Flattening the terrain based on your current height.
        Raising: Using stored soil to build defensive walls.

    Weapon Arsenal Expansion: * Assault Rifles: High-velocity rounds and rapid fire for hostile expeditions.

        Siege Weapons: Heavy ordinance for clearing dense clusters of enemies.
        Non-Lethal/Traumatic Weapons: Low-cost self-defense tools for urban environments and NPC encounters.

    Exo-Suit Integration: All equipment is now directly powered by your Exo-Suit. Energy consumption (both passive and active) must be managed during combat.

    Comprehensive Bomb System: Added two categories of explosives: Remote (detonated via signal) and Timer (direct activation).
        Security: Added PIN-code locking and Decryption devices to prevent unauthorized tampering.
        Power Tiers: Scalable charges from "Small" (precise mining) to "Nuclear" (biome-scale destruction and permanent terraforming).
    Physics-Based Rigging: NPC skeletons are now fully integrated with the physics engine, making combat movements and reactions significantly more realistic.
    UI/UX Updates: Refreshed tool management interface and added a new notification system for equipment status.



Music by https://pixabay.com/users/audioknap-52540465/?utm_source=link-attribution&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=music&utm_content=420040
